title: release r24: deepen evidence — 201 specific technical bases replace generic statute-only citations
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- 433 hazards whose only direct evidence was blanket mother-law clauses reviewed in 6 sequential passes: 196 gained a specific technical direct clause (201 new links), 237 honestly skipped (mainly the occupational-health series, no matching specific clause in the verified library).
- Mother-law direct links demoted to supporting per the established convention (215, hashes rebound).
- Restored 19 link reviews wrongly removed by a filename-based orphan cleanup (the gate indexes reviews by entityId).
- Gate six-phase PASS (1496 / 1875, strictBlockers=0), validate BLOCKING none, strict audit PASS, bundle verify errors=[].
- site-selection -> unified-v4-reviewed-20260912-r24.
